title: 第25章 逼迫第26章 七大神兵
slug: 锦衣卫开局手刃内奸上司
content_zh:
因此，虽然江辰感觉到了很大的压力，但他却并非无法承受。
他深吸一口气，将体内的真气运转到极致，努力抵挡着七王爷的压迫。
他的肌肉在压力下紧绷着，仿佛每一块都在发出低沉的咆哮，展现出他远超一般武者的坚韧。
七王爷见状，眼中闪过一丝惊讶。
他没想到这个看似不起眼的先天境武者，竟然能够在他的压迫下坚持这么久。
不过，他并没有因此而收手，反而加大了力量的输出，想要看看江辰的极限到底在哪里。
然而，江辰却并没有让他失望。
他咬紧牙关，凭借着十三重龙象般若功的强大力量，依旧稳稳地站在原地，与七王爷的压迫进行着顽强的对抗。
大概一盏茶功夫过后，七王爷朱开山脸上逐渐出现了一丝狰狞之色。
在他看来，锦衣卫的东西都是他朱家的东西。
所以他才舍不得将真正的宝贝拱手让给他人。
所以想要兑换真正的宝物，都要先把他伺候舒服了再说。
明皇知道这件事，但面对自己的亲弟弟也颇为无奈，只能不闻不问，假装他不存在。
但是没想到他今天碰上了江辰这么个死心眼，一点也不肯退让，现在把朱开山给架在这里了。
朱开山身为宗师境圆满的强者，原本以为只要轻轻动用自身的威压，就足以让眼前这个看似弱小的对手乖乖就范，如同蝼蚁般屈服在他的脚下。
然而，事实却远远出乎他的意料。
江辰站在那里，身形稳如磐石，他的肉身硬的像一块经过千锤百炼的生铁，任凭朱开山的威压如何汹涌澎湃，都无法在其身上留下丝毫的痕迹。
那威压如同狂风骤雨般袭来，却只能激起江辰体内潜藏的力量，而无法撼动其分毫。
朱开山此刻也急了，他的脸色变得铁青，眼神中闪烁着愤怒之色。
他身为明皇的亲弟弟，何时受过这样的挫折？

尤其是在这么多人面前，他更是不能容忍自己折了面子。
于是，他将威压催动到了极致，企图用更强大的力量来压垮江辰。
然而，江辰却并没有因此而感到恐惧。
相反，他感受到了朱开山那恐怖的威压所带来的机遇。
他知道，这正是锤炼自身真气、提升实力的绝佳机会。
于是，他深吸一口气，将全身的注意力都集中在了体内真气的运转上。
江辰开始利用朱开山那如潮水般涌来的威压，不断地锤炼自身的真气。
那真气在他的体内如同沸腾的开水般汹涌澎湃，每一次与威压的碰撞都让他感到一种难以言喻的痛快。
他的肉身也在这股力量的冲击下变得更加坚韧。
十三重龙象般若功的真气，如同江河之水，滔滔不绝地在江辰的身体之中涌动，带着一股不可阻挡的力量。
content_en:
Therefore, although Jiang Chen felt a lot of pressure, he was not unable to bear it.
He took a deep breath, circulated the zhenqi in his body to the extreme, and tried hard to resist the oppression of the Seventh Prince.
His muscles tensed under the pressure, as if every one of them was emitting a low roar, showing that he was far more tenacious than ordinary warriors.
When the seventh prince saw this, a trace of surprise flashed in his eyes.
He didn't expect that this seemingly inconspicuous Xiantian realm warrior could persist for so long under his oppression.
However, he did not stop because of this, but instead increased his power output, wanting to see where Jiang Chen's limit was.
However, Jiang Chen did not disappoint him.
He gritted his teeth and relied on the powerful power of the thirteenth level Dragon Elephant Prajna Kung Fu to still stand firmly on the spot, fighting tenaciously against the oppression of the Seventh Prince.
After about a cup of tea, a ferocious look gradually appeared on the face of Seventh Prince Zhu Kaishan.
In his opinion, Jin Yiwei's things belong to his Zhu family.
That's why he was reluctant to give up his real treasure to others.
Therefore, if you want to exchange for real treasures, you must first feel comfortable serving him.
Emperor Ming knew about this, but he was quite helpless in the face of his own brother, so he could only ignore it and pretend that he did not exist.
But he didn't expect that he would encounter Jiang Chen who was so stubborn today and refused to give in at all, and now Zhu Kaishan is being held here.
As a strong man who has reached the master level, Zhu Kaishan originally thought that just using his own pressure would be enough to make the seemingly weak opponent in front of him obediently submit and succumb to his feet like an ant.
However, the reality was far beyond his expectation.
Jiang Chen stood there, his body as steady as a rock, and his body as hard as a piece of pig iron that had been tempered for thousands of times. No matter how surging Zhu Kaishan's pressure was, he could not leave the slightest trace on his body.
The coercion came like a violent storm, but it could only arouse the power hidden in Jiang Chen's body, but could not shake it at all.
Zhu Kaishan was also anxious at this moment, his face turned livid, and his eyes flashed with anger.
As the younger brother of Emperor Ming, when had he ever suffered such a setback?
Especially in front of so many people, he couldn't tolerate losing face.
Therefore, he pushed the pressure to the extreme, trying to use more powerful force to crush Jiang Chen.
However, Jiang Chen did not feel afraid because of this.
On the contrary, he felt the opportunity brought by Zhu Kaishan's terrifying pressure.
He knew that this was the perfect opportunity to hone his energy and improve his strength.
So, he took a deep breath and focused all his attention on the movement of Qi in his body.
Jiang Chen began to use Zhu Kaishan's pressure coming like a tide to continuously temper his own Qi.
The true energy surged in his body like boiling water, and every collision with pressure made him feel an indescribable pleasure.
His physical body also became stronger under the impact of this force.
The true energy of the thirteenth level Dragon Elephant Prajna Kung Fu was like the water of a river, surging in Jiang Chen's body endlessly, carrying an unstoppable force.
